title: A tick or a deny, right where I write (2026-10-24)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
We are currently managing affirmations different elements in the method editor. This should be using the same tooling as method and essay to create a way to manage things inline.

It's method editor based rather than the essay, but we should use generic code.

I need to be able to affirm or deny a structured record created from my text - or linked by an agent right next to where I write. just a tick or a deny. With some detailed guidance in comments on the link from the paragraph.  We could probably allow a link to a problem or remedy to also be linked to a comment. So a comment can say what link it added cleanly - then I can thumb up or down on the comment.
